svg.title: Figure 8-1: safety function by task
svg.desc: A grid with the twelve safety functions down the side and the eleven tasks across; teal cells where the function is active and claimed, dashed teal where it is present but not the claimed measure, grey where it inhibits, amber for the armed bench image, white where it does not apply; each cell carries the qualifier of the table.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 8-1 Which safety function is active in which task

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cells from the §8 table. Teal: active and claimed; dashed teal: present but not the claimed measure; grey: the function inhibits; amber: the bench paths are admitted under arming; white: not applicable.
